name: seaside-candle-works-backend
description: NestJS API for Seaside Candle Works — catalogue, cart pricing, orders, messages and shop admin.

scripts.db:reset: node -e "require('fs').rmSync(require('path').resolve(process.env.DATABASE_DIR || '../database', 'app.sqlite'), { force: true }); console.log('Database removed — it will be recreated and seeded on next start.')"
